snippet.title: 3 Socks Is Enough! 🧦 Riddle #17 Answer + Riddle #18: Three Tablets ⏰ #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's riddle: 10 black socks and 10 white socks, in total darkness. How many to be SURE of a pair?
Take two, and you could get one black and one white. But the third sock has to match one of them, because there are only two colours. The answer is 3. ✅

Riddle #18 ⏰
Person 1 is ill, and the doctor gives three tablets.
Take one tablet every half hour, starting right now.
Person 2 says that takes 90 minutes. Person 3 says: no way!

How many minutes until all three tablets are taken?
Comment 1, 2 or 3:
1) 90 minutes
2) 60 minutes
3) 30 minutes
The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. ☀️

#riddle #riddles #brainteaser #puzzle #logicpuzzle #solvebysunrise #shorts
